description.value: Alfa Greco Roman Cuisine is a long-running Greek restaurant in Tsawwassen that has served the community since 1979, making it one of the area's most enduring eateries. The menu spans classic Greek fare — souvlaki platters, kalamari, spanakopita, and homemade dips — alongside pizzas, pastas, and BBQ ribs, offering substantial post-ride meals. Catering, table reservations, and both dine-in and pick-up options make it a flexible stop for solo riders and cycling groups alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at alfapizza.net is live and confirms the OSM address (1097 56 Street, Delta V4L 2A2), primary phone (604-943-7471), and that the business is an active sit-down Greek restaurant. OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:gluten_free=yes are corroborated by the menu page, which shows multiple vegetarian items (spanakopita, hummus, tzatziki) and the gluten-free tag is plausible given menu options. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or Wi-Fi, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM name is 'Alfa' but the website consistently uses 'Alfa Greco Roman Cuisine' — name mismatch worth aligning.
OSM community field says 'Tsawwassen' but the website and mailing address use 'Delta' (Tsawwassen is a neighbourhood within Delta Municipality — minor but worth standardizing).
Website lists a second phone number (604-943-7472) not present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Alfa is a well-established, active Greek restaurant with vegetarian/GF options and pick-up service suitable for cyclists, but no evidence of bike parking or visibility was found — a required WWC criterion. A site visit or direct confirmation of bike parking is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant was founded in 1979; current owner Hojjat took over in 2020. Email on website: alfagrecoromancuisine@gmail.com (contact page) and Alfapizza1979@gmail.com (footer).

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Dine-in and Pick-up only' for specials; catering page confirms 'We offer both dining and delivery, as well as pick-up.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists multiple vegetarian items (spanakopita, homous, tzatziki, dolmades, salads). No explicit vegan confirmation
